load_weights_from_snapshot: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a session with optional discard and rename filters
load_weights_to_dict: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a dictionary with optional discard and rename filters
load_weights_from_snapshot_discard: load checkpoint weights into a session while discarding variables matching a discard list
load_weights_from_snapshot_rename: load checkpoint weights into a session while renaming variable keys via a rename dictionary
load_weights_to_dict_discard: load checkpoint weights into a dictionary while discarding variables matching a discard list
